title: Famulus snapshot_ref (contract C4)
description: Reference to one snapshot set created by org.famulus.Snapshot1.Create. Format: famulus-snap/<event_id>/<subvols>@<unix_ts>. <event_id> is the lowercase UUIDv7 of the C1 audit event that triggered the snapshot. <subvols> is one or more btrfs subvolume names (each matching [a-z0-9._-]+) joined by "+" in the order passed to Create. <unix_ts> is integer seconds since the Unix epoch at snapshot creation time. Example: famulus-snap/019811a2-7c3e-7d10-9b8a-3f2e1d0c4b5a/etc+var@1751884800
